thread:
maya (people-ops): Hi team — quick triage for Lina's Day 1 (Tue). She's hired on the US entity but is currently in the UK. Need to confirm: I-9 completion approach, background check status, laptop + badge handoff, and a light day-1 orientation schedule. Can we sync logistics here?

sam (it): +1. I can prepare a laptop image and pre-stage Okta/Slack. Do we want to ship to UK or have her pick up in SF if she flies?

maya (people-ops): Shipping to UK preferred by candidate. We need confirmation on I-9 because she can't present docs in person in the US. Jorge, can we do the authorized agent route?

jorge (hr): For US I-9, remote hires outside the US are a bit tricky. Options: 1) Hire under local entity (but hiring manager already chose US payroll), 2) Use an Authorized Representative (notary/agent) to verify documents + sign Section 2, then we keep copy. We can accept a qualified notary or an employer-authorized rep per E-Verify guidance. Need candidate consent and agent info.

lina (new hire): I can do a notary appointment here in London. There are mobile notaries that come to you. I should also be able to scan passport + gov ID for pre-check, then present originals to the notary.

maya (people-ops): Perfect. Lina — please confirm which day/time you'd like the notary. Also please upload scanned copies to the private intake link so we can begin background check. Link: https://redwood-internal/secure/onboard-intake (use SSO).

lina (new hire): Booked mobile notary for Mon 2pm BST. Uploaded scans just now. 

bgcheck-bot: Background check ordered for Lina — domestic + global screens. Vendor: Clearview HR. Status: initiated. Estimated turnaround 24-72 hrs for primary checks; international verifications may take longer. Ticket: CHK-91724.

sam (it): FYI for IT shipping: send 1x MacBook Air (16GB), pre-enrolled MDM, ethernet dongle. Shipping label: to candidate address on file. If custom duties apply, courier-ops will bill Redwood.

courier-ops: Noted. Estimated transit DHL Express 2-4 business days to UK central London. Want signature on delivery?

maya (people-ops): Yes signature required. Also need temporary building badge process: Tom?

tom (facilities): For remote hires we can issue a temporary digital visitor pass if they come to SF later; otherwise for access requests when they visit we'll have a guest escort. Lina — if you plan any SF visits in first 90 days, tell us the date and we'll pre-provision a card.

lina (new hire): No SF visits planned yet. Will update if that changes.

jorge (hr): Two quick items — benefits enrollment window opens Day 1. We'll send an email with benefits portal link and the ERS code. Also, confirm pay-start date (we've set payroll to next cycle).

maya (people-ops): I'll draft Day-1 agenda for Lina: 09:00 welcome + compliance overview (HR), 10:00 IT set-up call, 11:00 manager intro, 12:00 lunch (virtual team welcome), 13:00 benefits walkthrough, 14:00 product orientation and doc tour. Any objections?

sam (it): Works for me. Add a 30-min 1:1 to cover MFA edge cases (we sometimes need a screen-share to approve Okta).

maya (people-ops): Good call — inserting 15:30 1:1 with IT.

bgcheck-bot: Update: international verification (UK) requires document attestation—vendor has assigned caseworker. ETA +48 hours.

maya (people-ops): Thanks — please ping if anything flags. Lina, last ask: send a photo for badge template (headshot) and confirm emergency contact.

lina (new hire): Sent headshot and emergency contact via the secure intake link. Thanks everyone! :smile:

maya (people-ops): Great — closing checklist: 1) Notary appointment confirmed (Mon 2pm BST) 2) Background check initiated (CHK-91724) 3) Laptop shipped DHL Express, signature required 4) Temporary access handled on visit 5) Day-1 agenda scheduled. Reopen thread if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
